  .eg-content-card ol { margin-bottom: var(--space-4); padding-left: 20px; }
  .eg-content-card strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

  /* F2P note card */
  .eg-note-card {
    background: rgba(250,204,21,0.06);
    border-color: rgba(250,204,21,0.3);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-6);
  }
  .eg-note-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.7; }

  /* Team example box */
  .eg-team-example {
    background: rgba(168,85,247,0.1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.5);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-4) 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  }
  .eg-team-example h4 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--accent-gold); }
  .eg-team-example p { margin-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-secondary); }

  /* Warning box */
  .eg-warning-box {
    background: rgba(220,38,38,0.08); border-left: 3px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.45);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-4) 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  }
  .eg-warning-box h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #fca5a5; font-size: var(--text-base); }
  .eg-warning-box p { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* - PHASE GRID - */
  .phase-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
  }
  .phase-card {
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
    border: 1px solid;
  }
  .phase-label {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  }
  .phase-desc { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }
  .phase-early { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.07); border-color: rgba(74,222,128,0.3); }
  .phase-early .phase-label { color: #86efac; }
  .phase-mid { background: rgba(250,204,21,0.07); border-color: rgba(250,204,21,0.3); }
  .phase-mid .phase-label { color: var(--accent-gold); }
  .phase-late { background: rgba(168,85,247,0.07); border-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.3); }
  .phase-late .phase-label { color: #c4b5fd; }

  /* - STAR HEROES SPLIT - */
  .star-split {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
  }
  .star-box {
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-5);
    border: 1px solid;
  }
  .star-box-title {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  }
  .star-box-note { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: var(--space-3); line-height: 1.5; }
  .star-good { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.06); border-color: rgba(74,222,128,0.25); }
  .star-good .star-box-title { color: #86efac; }
  .star-invest { background: rgba(251,146,60,0.06); border-color: rgba(251,146,60,0.25); }
  .star-invest .star-box-title { color: #fdba74; }

  /* - HERO PILLS - */
  .hero-pill {
    display: inline-block;
    background: rgba(168,85,247,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.3);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-4);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .hero-pill.pill-highlight {
    background: rgba(168,85,247,0.25);
    border-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.5);
    color: #e9d5ff;
  }
  .hero-pill.comp-or {
    background: none;
    border-color: transparent;
    color: var(--text-disabled);
    font-weight: var(--weight-normal);
    font-style: italic;
    padding: var(--space-1);
  }
  .hero-pill.comp-flex {
    background: rgba(250,204,21,0.1);
    border-color: rgba(250,204,21,0.3);
    color: var(--accent-gold);
  }
  .hero-pills {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-2);
    margin: var(--space-3) 0;
    align-items: center;
  }

  /* - PHASE ROW GRID (DD section) - */
  .phase-row-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4); margin: var(--space-4) 0; }
  .phase-row {
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
  }
  .phase-row-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  }
  .early-label { color: #86efac; }
  .late-label { color: #c4b5fd; }

  /* - SUPPORT TIERS - */
  .support-tiers { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); margin: var(--space-4) 0; }
  .support-tier {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
  }
  .support-tier-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* - HERO PORTRAIT CARDS (tips-specific, larger 64px variant) - */
  .hero-chip-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: var(--space-2) 0;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .hero-chip {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-1);
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    width: 64px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .hero-chip-portrait {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center top 25%;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .hero-chip:hover .hero-chip-portrait {
    border-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168,85,247,0.3);
  }
  .hero-chip.chip-highlight .hero-chip-portrait {
    border-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(168,85,247,0.2);
  }
  .hero-chip-name {
    font-size: 0.67rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
    line-height: 1.3;
    max-width: 64px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .chip-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    align-self: center;
    color: var(--text-disabled);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-style: italic;
    padding: 0 2px;
    margin-top: -10px;
  }
  .chip-flex-slot {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-1);
    width: 64px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .chip-flex-img {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border: 1px dashed rgba(250,204,21,0.4);
    background: rgba(250,204,21,0.04);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: rgba(250,204,21,0.4);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }
  .chip-flex-label {
    font-size: 0.67rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  }

  /* - TEAM COMP CARDS - */
  .comp-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4); margin-top: var(--space-5); }
  .comp-entry {
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.2);
    border-left: 3px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.5);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
  }
  .comp-label {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  }
  .comp-notes {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    line-height: 1.65;
    margin: var(--space-3) 0 0;
  }

  /* - ODYSSEY MILESTONE TABLE - */
  .milestone-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
    display: table;
  }
  .milestone-row {
    display: table-row;
  }
  .milestone-chapter, .milestone-unlock, .milestone-why {
    display: table-cell;
    padding: var(--space-3);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .milestone-header .milestone-chapter,
  .milestone-header .milestone-unlock,
  .milestone-header .milestone-why {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  }
  .milestone-chapter { width: 80px; font-weight: var(--weight-bold); color: #a78bfa; }
  .milestone-highlight .milestone-chapter { color: #f59e0b; }
  .milestone-highlight .milestone-unlock,
  .milestone-highlight .milestone-why { color: #fde68a; }

  /* - PINION TABLE - */
  .pinion-table {
    width: 100%;
    display: table;
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
  }
  .pinion-row { display: table-row; }
  .pinion-type, .pinion-pool, .pinion-when {
    display: table-cell;
    padding: var(--space-3);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .pinion-header .pinion-type,
  .pinion-header .pinion-pool,
  .pinion-header .pinion-when {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  }
  .pinion-type { width: 160px; font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); color: #60a5fa; }

  /* - MISTAKES LIST - */
  .mistakes-list {
    margin: var(--space-3) 0 0;
    padding-left: 20px;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }
  .mistakes-list li { margin-bottom: var(--space-2); }

  /* - CORE RULE CARD - */
  .eg-core-rule-card { border-left: 3px solid #a78bfa; }
  .core-rule-split {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
  }
  .core-rule-carry, .core-rule-support {
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-4);
  }
  .core-rule-carry { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.25); }
  .core-rule-support { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.25); }
  .core-rule-label {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  }
  .core-rule-carry .core-rule-label { color: #fca5a5; }
  .core-rule-support .core-rule-label { color: #93c5fd; }
  .core-rule-carry p, .core-rule-support p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; }

  /* - GEAR PRIORITY LIST - */
  .gear-priority-list { margin: var(--space-3) 0 var(--space-3); padding-left: 20px; line-height: 1.9; }

  /* - DIANA / DIONYSUS BOX - */
  .diana-dionysus-box {
    margin-top: var(--space-5);
    padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
  }
  .diana-dionysus-box h3 { margin-top: 0; font-size: var(--text-base); }
  .dd-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-4); margin-top: var(--space-3); }
  .dd-card {
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: var(--space-4);
  }
  .dd-beginner { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.25); }
  .dd-advanced { background: rgba(251,191,36,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.25); }
  .dd-label {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  }
  .dd-beginner .dd-label { color: #86efac; }
  .dd-advanced .dd-label { color: #fde68a; }
  .dd-card p { font-size: 0.88rem; margin: 0 0 var(--space-2); }
  .dd-tag { color: var(--text-muted) !important; font-size: 0.8rem !important; }

  /* - WISH LIST - */
  .wishlist-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-5); margin-top: var(--space-4); }
  .wishlist-faction {
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-faint);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-4);
  }
  .wishlist-faction-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  }
  .wishlist-note {
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin: var(--space-3) 0 0;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  /* - SHRINE TAB STYLES - */
  .shrine-main-content {
    max-width: var(--page-max-width);
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: var(--space-10) var(--space-6) var(--space-20);
  }
  .sh-tldr-box {
    background: rgba(168,85,247,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.3);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-6); margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
  }
  .sh-tldr-title { font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); color: var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom: var(--space-3); }
  .sh-tldr-list { padding-left: 18px; }
  .sh-tldr-list li { color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: var(--space-2); }

  /* Shrine TOC */
  .sh-toc-card {
    background: rgba(250,204,21,0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(250,204,21,0.2);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-6);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
  }
  .sh-toc-title {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(250,204,21,0.7);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
  }
  .sh-toc-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-3);
  }
  .sh-toc-item {
    background: rgba(250,204,21,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(250,204,21,0.2);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: var(--transition-colors);
  }
  .sh-toc-item:hover { background: rgba(250,204,21,0.15); border-color: rgba(250,204,21,0.4); }

  /* Shrine sections */
  #shrine-general, #shrine-placement, #shrine-artefacts,
  #shrine-seats, #shrine-talismans, #shrine-setups {
    scroll-margin-top: 80px;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
  }

  .sh-content-card { margin-bottom: var(--space-8); }
  .sh-content-card h2 {
    margin-top: var(--space-6); margin-bottom: var(--space-4); font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--accent-gold);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(250,204,21,0.2); padding-bottom: var(--space-3);
  }
  .sh-content-card h3 { margin-top: var(--space-6); margin-bottom: var(--space-3); font-size: 1.2rem; color: #c4b5fd; }
  .sh-content-card h4 { margin-top: var(--space-4); margin-bottom: var(--space-2); font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .sh-content-card p { line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: var(--space-4); color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .sh-content-card ul, .sh-content-card ol { line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: var(--space-4); color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .sh-content-card li { margin-bottom: var(--space-3); }
  .sh-content-card strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
  .sh-warning-box {
    background: rgba(251,146,60,0.1); padding: var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-5) 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border-left: 3px solid rgba(251,146,60,0.4);
  }
  .sh-warning-box h3 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--accent-gold); font-size: var(--text-base); }
  .sh-info-box { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1); padding: var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-5) 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .sh-info-box h4 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--accent-gold); }
  .sh-tip-box { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.07); padding: var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-5) 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .sh-tip-box h4 { margin-top: 0; color: #86efac; }
  .sh-progression-box {
    background: rgba(250,204,21,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(250,204,21,0.3);
    padding: var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-5) 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); text-align: center;
  }
  .sh-progression-box h4 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--accent-gold); }
  .sh-rarity-box { background: var(--bg-raised); padding: var(--space-5); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); margin: var(--space-5) 0; }
  .sh-rarity-box h4 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--accent-gold); text-align: center; }
  .comparison-box { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-5); margin: var(--space-5) 0; }
  .compare-section { background: var(--chip-bg); padding: var(--space-5); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.25); }
  .compare-section h4 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--accent-gold); }
  .seats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: var(--space-5); margin-top: var(--space-5); }
  .seat-card { background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.35); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: var(--space-5); transition: var(--transition-colors); }
  .seat-card:hover { border-color: rgba(250,204,21,0.5); }
  .seat-header { margin-bottom: var(--space-4); }
  .seat-header h3 { margin: 0 0 var(--space-2) 0; color: var(--accent-gold); font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .seat-position { font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); }
  .seat-specialty { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); margin-bottom: var(--space-4); font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .level-unlock { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-2); margin-top: var(--space-4); }
  .upgrade-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-3); background: var(--bg-raised); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .upgrade-label { background: rgba(74,222,128,0.2); color: #86efac; padding: 2px var(--space-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-weight: var(--weight-bold); font-size: 0.72rem; min-width: 60px; text-align: center; align-self: flex-start; white-space: nowrap; }
  .upgrade-text { color: #86efac; font-size: 0.83rem; line-height: 1.4; }
  .talisman-effects ul { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: var(--space-3); }
  .rarity-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); margin-top: var(--space-4); }
  .rarity-item { padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); text-align: center; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .rarity-low { background: rgba(156,163,175,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(156,163,175,0.5); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .rarity-mid { background: rgba(168,85,247,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.5); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .rarity-high { background: var(--accent-gold-dim); border: 1px solid rgba(250,204,21,0.5); color: var(--accent-gold); }

# Component Plan
Design System Phase 3 - Component extraction roadmap.
Source of truth: guides.astro (Goldstandard), heroes/[id].astro (detail page).

---

## Status Legend
- [ ] planned
- [~] in progress
- [x] done

---

## 1. Already in components.css (existing, needs cleanup)

| Class group         | Status | Notes |
|---------------------|--------|-------|
| `.page-wrapper`     | [~]    | Duplicated in components.css AND base.css. Remove from components.css. |
| `.content-wrapper`  | [ ]    | Redundant with `.page-wrapper`, different max-width (1200px). Audit usage, consolidate or remove. |
| `.main-content`     | [ ]    | Used by calculator.astro. Token-ify padding values. |
| `.page-header/title/subtitle` | [ ] | Used by several pages. Token-ify font-size to `--text-2xl`. |
| `.separator`        | [ ]    | Hardcoded color. Replace with `rgba(var(--accent-gold), 0.4)` via token. |
| `.tab-bar / .tab`   | [x]    | Well-structured, already uses token vars. Keep as-is. |
| `.main-tabs / .main-tab` | [ ] | Parallel system to `.boss-tabbar`. Consolidate into one pill-tab pattern. |
| `.boss-tabbar / .boss-tab` | [ ] | Same pattern as `.event-tabbar`. Already merged via selector. Good. |
| `.support-card` group | [ ] | Self-contained, no duplication. Token-ify hardcoded px values. |

---

## 2. Patterns to extract (new components)

Priority: HIGH = used on 3+ pages, MEDIUM = 2 pages, LOW = 1 page but important.

---

### 2.1 HeroChip
**Priority: HIGH**
**Source: guides.astro, bosses.astro, tips.astro**

A small hero portrait + name tag used inline in team comp rows.

```
Structure:
.hero-chip
  .hero-chip-portrait   (CSS background-image div, 36x36px)
  span                  (hero name text)
```

CSS location: `components.css`
Astro component: `src/components/HeroChip.astro` (props: heroId, name)

Variants observed:
- guides.astro: `.hero-chip` with `.hero-portrait` inner div
- bosses.astro: identical structure, same class names
- tips.astro: `.hero-pic` / `.hero-pic-img` (rename to match standard)

Token dependencies: `--bg-raised`, `--border-subtle`, `--radius-full`, `--text-sm`

---

### 2.2 CompEntry
**Priority: HIGH**
**Source: guides.astro, bosses.astro**

A team composition block: header with label + reason, hero chip row, optional notes.

```
Structure:
.comp-entry
  .comp-entry-header
    .comp-label           (e.g. "PvP Core")
    .comp-reason          (short description text)
  .comp-hero-row
    HeroChip x N
  .comp-notes             (optional italic note)
```

CSS location: `components.css`
Astro component: `src/components/CompEntry.astro`
(props: label, reason, heroes[], notes?)

Differences to resolve:
- tips.astro uses `.comp-card / .comp-title / .comp-note` - migrate to standard naming
- bosses.astro is already aligned with guides.astro naming

Token dependencies: `--bg-surface`, `--border-subtle`, `--radius-lg`, `--text-sm`, `--text-muted`

---

### 2.3 RatingBadge
**Priority: HIGH**
**Source: heros.astro, heroes/[id].astro, HeroCard.astro**

Colored pill displaying a tier rating (SSS, SS, S, A, B, C).

```
Structure:
.rating-badge[data-tier="SSS"]   (or class .tier-sss)
  text content
```

CSS: gradient background from `--tier-{x}-from` to `--tier-{x}-to`, text from `--tier-{x}-text`.
Already implemented in `HeroCard.astro` and `[id].astro` - extract shared CSS to components.css.

Astro component: `src/components/RatingBadge.astro`
(props: tier, label?)

Token dependencies: full `--tier-*` system (already in tokens.css)

---

### 2.4 SectionLabel / SectionHeader
**Priority: HIGH**
**Source: heroes/[id].astro, guides.astro, heros.astro**

Section kicker + title pattern with optional decorative bar.

```
Variant A (kicker + title, used in [id].astro):
.content-section
  .section-label     (uppercase kicker, gold, --tracking-widest)
  h2                 (section title)

Variant B (bar-decorated title, used in guides.astro):
.section-title
  ::before / ::after pseudo-elements as horizontal bars
```

CSS location: `components.css`
No Astro component needed - pure CSS pattern.

Token dependencies: `--section-kicker-*`, `--section-title-*`, `--accent-gold`, `--border-subtle`

---

### 2.5 Accordion
**Priority: MEDIUM**
**Source: guides.astro, bosses.astro**

Image-backed nav item that expands to reveal content. Toggled via `.is-active` JS class.

```
Structure:
.accordion-nav
  .accordion-item[.is-active]
    .accordion-trigger    (button, image background, overlay label)
    .accordion-content    (collapsible, height: 0 / auto)
```

CSS location: `components.css`
JS: toggle `.is-active` on click, one open at a time.

Differences:
- guides.astro: slide-style accordion (hero per slide)
- bosses.astro: boss selection accordion (height 200px image)
Both use same `.is-active` toggle pattern.

Token dependencies: `--radius-lg`, `--border-subtle`, `--bg-raised`, `--transition-all`, `--duration-slow`

---

### 2.6 MechanicBox
**Priority: MEDIUM**
**Source: guides.astro, bosses.astro**

Color-coded info box for game mechanic explanations.

```
Structure:
.mechanic-box[data-type="warning|info|tip|phase"]
  .mechanic-box-label   (uppercase tag)
  p                     (content text)
```

Color system:
- default: `--accent-teal` border + dim bg
- warning: amber / gold tones
- phase: purple tones
